Senses.Explanation: To break through Caizhou evokes the taking of a defended stronghold. In Chan records it becomes a compact victory-and-defeat verdict: a later word can complete the breakthrough, while a timely response can keep a position from being overrun. Yunfeng says Nanquan’s final word saved him from having Caizhou broken; Dahui reverses the appraisal and says that very final word broke it at once. Muchen Daomin repeatedly applies the formula to cases and live hall turns. Langye Huijue says Guishan’s response kept the stronghold from being broken; two collections preserve that same Langye utterance, but it counts as one deployment class.
